from collections import defaultdict as DD

def solve(g):
    g=tuple(map(tuple,g))
    O=[o for o in objects(g,True,False,True) if len(o)>1]
    groups=DD(list)
    for o in O: groups[tuple(sorted(toindices(normalize(o))))].append(o)
    pairs=[v for v in groups.values() if len(v)>1]
    # marker: L-shaped object (vertical line + horizontal arm)
    marker=None
    for o in O:
        idx=toindices(o)
        ulc=ulcorner(o); lrc=lrcorner(o)
        # try: exists a column fully spanning rows, plus arm at bottom
        cols=DD(list); rows=DD(list)
        for i,j in idx: cols[j].append(i); rows[i].append(j)
        for j,colrows in cols.items():
            colrows=sorted(colrows)
            if colrows[-1]-colrows[0]+1==len(colrows) and len(colrows)>1:
                bottom=colrows[-1]
                arm=[jj for (ii,jj) in idx if ii==bottom]
                arm=sorted(arm)
                if len(arm)>1 and (min(arm)<=j<=max(arm)):
                    # rest = vertical line
                    if len(o)==len(colrows)+len(arm)-1:
                        marker=o; elbow=(bottom,j)
    assert marker is not None
    mc=color(marker)
    pair=max(pairs,key=lambda v:len(v[0]))
    assert len(pair)==2, pairs
    a,b=pair
    da=manhattan(ulcorner(a),elbow); db=manhattan(ulcorner(b),elbow)
    tgt=b if db>da else a
    return paint(g, recolor(mc, toindices(tgt)))

    gi=tuple(map(tuple,G[n+' input'])); go=tuple(map(tuple,G[n+' output']))
